known_native_work.excludes: Unflushed interrupted work, earlier V1/development/normalization and native engineering benchmarks; excluded work is not zero

logical_tariff.definition: Common first couple is charged once; a non-stop final continuation adds one charge. Final decoding still runs for stop.

nonduplicated_predeployment_work.excludes: verification, original V1/pretraining, unmetered development, interrupted and recovered primary deployment; these are separate, not zero

pilot.classification: shared actuator and fixed-action search; counted once
pilot.derivation: Recorded gradients; hard-forward counts reconstructed from baseline five-action selection, initial/checkpoint response panels and final selection/clean panels in frozen pilot.py

additional_postdecision_observer_work.derivation: Frozen deploy_batch calls observe_tensors for reward and audit after finish; each observer classifies left/right digits. This work is outside prepare/finish counters.

recovered_primary_deployment.aggregation_rule: For each resource sum group mean times rows_with_measurement over 22 disjoint split/arm groups; integer recovery tolerance 0.001. No global median or p95 inferred from group quantiles.
recovered_primary_deployment.global_elapsed_interpretation: The three seed jobs ran concurrently; duration-only metadata does not identify shared start/end elapsed time. Do not sum their approximately 313-second durations.

runtime_fitting.classification: nine shared checkpoint-specific runtime banks; same banks fit native and history
runtime_fitting.deduplication: Each public bank and native feature extraction is generated once per profile/transform and reused across fitted families/penalties
